notes: The faithful run uses mesh_detail = 1.0 and keeps the solidify modifiers, so vertex counts are directly comparable with the committed model.
The committed model carries a procedural scale normal map image; the parametric builder drops it (it is a texture, not geometry), which is the whole byte-size difference.
Morph-target builds necessarily differ: mesh_detail is 0.62 and solidify is off, because Blender cannot apply a modifier to a mesh that carries shape keys.
